stories.title: Las consecuencias de las mentiras de Zapatero sobre sus joyas: “Nadie se ve compartiendo escenario en un mitin con él”

en.title: The consequences of Zapatero's lies about his jewels: "Nobody sees themselves sharing a stage at a rally with him"
en.summary: An examination of contradictory statements by the former Spanish president regarding jewels valued at 1.3 million euros reveals significant discontent within the PSOE party.

stories.title: La ola de indignación por el caso Maricarmen presiona a Junts antes de una votación clave por los desahucios

en.title: Wave of outrage over Maricarmen case pressures Junts before crucial eviction vote
en.summary: The pro-independence party navigates how to confront the government on a contentious issue while managing fallout from a situation that transcends political ideology.

stories.title: Delcy Rodríguez y Trump, la imagen del nuevo mundo

en.title: Delcy Rodríguez and Trump, the image of the new world
en.summary: A commentary on imagery showing Venezuelan government representatives alongside a figure characterized as having benefited from petroleum revenues.

stories.title: Penalización por subir el alquiler, facilidad para construir y protección del inquilino: los puntos calientes del decreto de vivienda

en.title: Penalties for raising rent, ease of building and tenant protection: the hotspots of the housing decree
en.summary: The government revives a housing regulation draft addressing rental penalties, construction facilitation, and tenant rights, creating tensions between different political groups.

stories.title: La impotencia dicta sentencia: “Descuartizó a mi madre y tuvimos que pactar para que no saliera de la cárcel”

en.title: Impotence dictates sentence: "He dismembered my mother and we had to make a deal so he wouldn't leave prison"
en.summary: The daughters of Carmen Ortiz, killed by her ex-partner in 2021, express regret that they will never receive compensation and remain unaware of the full truth surrounding her death.

stories.title: Zapatero se enfrenta al mismo silencio de los saudíes que Juan Carlos I con los regalos del rey Abdalá

en.title: Zapatero faces the same Saudi silence as Juan Carlos I did over King Abdullah's gifts
en.summary: Switzerland abandoned efforts to request Saudi Arabian collaboration in investigating 65 million euros linked to the former Spanish king.

stories.title: La deuda de la justicia con Dolores Vázquez: 25 años sin reparar los 519 días de cárcel de una inocente

en.title: Justice's debt to Dolores Vázquez: 25 years without redressing 519 days of prison for an innocent woman
en.summary: The Wanninkhof case exemplifies judicial failures including media trials, homophobia, and social mob justice that wrongfully imprisoned an innocent person while the actual killer continued to commit crimes.

stories.title: El Gobierno cede a la presión por Maricarmen y busca instrumentalizar el desahucio a su favor

en.title: The Government yields to pressure over Maricarmen and seeks to instrumentalize the eviction in its favor
en.summary: A housing eviction of an 87-year-old Madrid woman escalated tensions between coalition partners, with political factions disagreeing over the government's response to the residential crisis.

stories.title: Junts pide rebajas fiscales para aprobar el decreto antidesahucios tras el caso Maricarmen

en.title: Junts demands tax cuts to approve anti-eviction decree following the Maricarmen case

stories.title: El Gobierno busca una salida para evitar un 15-M de la vivienda: "El caso Maricarmen es un punto de inflexión"

en.title: Government seeks solution to prevent housing crisis uprising: "The Maricarmen case is an inflection point"
en.summary: Public pressure over an elderly woman's eviction has prompted the Socialist Government to consider emergency housing measures, with officials describing the situation as a potential social crisis.

stories.title: El relator de la ONU para Vivienda reprocha a la jueza no haber suspendido el desahucio de Maricarmen

en.title: UN housing rapporteur criticizes judge for not suspending Maricarmen's eviction
en.summary: The UN official stated that any eviction risking homelessness should be halted until local or regional authorities provide a viable alternative housing solution.

en.title: Delcy Rodríguez thanks Trump for his cooperation with Venezuela and announces elections without setting a date
en.summary: Venezuela's acting president addressed the UN General Assembly, expressing gratitude for Trump's cooperation while announcing upcoming elections without providing specific timing or mentioning the imprisoned Nicolás Maduro.

stories.title: El desahucio de Maricarmen: Mucho buitre (político) y poco fondo

en.title: The Maricarmen eviction: Much political opportunism and little substance

stories.title: Telefónica e Indra se alían en Defensa para satélites

stories.title: Unicaja: la demanda de prejubilaciones duplica la oferta del banco

en.title: Unicaja: demand for early retirement doubles the bank's offer

stories.title: O'Leary (Ryanair): "Aena nos incentiva a crecer solo en grandes aeropuertos"
